proposed_capability: P95 program seam: panel-specific semantic click targets and calibrated hitboxes for Sims 4, with a Playwright-like facade reused by approved host adapters. P124 maintain one atlas/queue/input owner rather than duplicate desktop clickers. Trifecta: P82 offline success/failure regression tests, P07 integrate, P08 game-host calibration and physical click certification.
player_save_control_impact: No auto-discovery, no direct Win32, no save edits, no automatic hardware input, no force-click or blind retries. Unverified panels, ambiguous labels, missing panel cues, stale layout, missing attested hitbox, player presence, wrong patch, or missing viewport provenance prohibit effects. A local agent must supply a separately authorized existing native screen owner.
expected_outcome: New schema-backed panel/action glossary for aspirations, career, skills, simology, Live personal inventory, needs, household inventory, and small business; an explicit unresolved 'skit' entry and combined skills/needs advisory, no invented coordinates. Extend existing screen_atlas calibration/observation guards to panel-specific exact-patch hitbox center with UI revision + visibility + visual/operator cue checks. Reuse existing cooperative single click and safe rest. Add regression tests and docs; keep BI-002 hunger open.
negative_tests: unknown or unresolved panel/action fails closed
cross-panel or wrong mode target rejected
layout revision, panel cues, selected Sim, or hitbox drift blocks action
underlying screenshot capture cannot imply live game proof
unchanged BUILD target and existing Playwright browser click/fill behavior preserved
human interruption cannot trigger second click
no force-click or side-effect from glossary inspection
rollback_path: Revert this feature PR; original chrome/scene/playwright/queue owners and Save/game-state remain unchanged.
unresolved_unknowns: Local native Sims screenshot segmentation and exact patch target rectangles must be captured and operator-attested
'skit' is intentionally unresolved until user or game evidence supplies the exact menu identity
Exact UI scaling, DPI, animation, occlusion and nested scroll behavior require host P08 observed trials
